scope: CVG-004 bounded authenticated append-only reversal of a full BRL encounter cash receipt

criteria.description: The reversal command validates UUIDs, bounded reason and idempotency, derives tenant and actor from the authenticated principal, and rechecks billing.manage inside the tenant transaction before idempotency lookup or replay.
criteria.limitations: The proof is local HTTP/application execution; target identity infrastructure and remote authorization stores remain outside scope.

criteria.description: One tenant transaction locks and validates the complete original full-BRL settlement, inserts the reversal row, withdrawal and inverse balanced journal, updates projections and appends audit/outbox evidence.
criteria.limitations: Provider refunds, bank reconciliation, fiscal cancellation and non-cash settlement are explicitly excluded.

criteria.description: The original settlement remains immutable; the reversal graph is protected against row, cash-movement, journal-entry and journal-line mutation; active receipt uniqueness, register timing and consistency checks remain enforced.
criteria.limitations: Direct privileged SQL outside the tested runtime-role path remains an operational control and target-environment acceptance item.

criteria.description: The reversal ledger and composite artifact relationships are tenant-scoped with RLS; fresh migrations apply cleanly; API and worker receive required settlement-helper EXECUTE privileges while PUBLIC does not.
criteria.limitations: The runtime-role proof uses disposable local PostgreSQL; target TCP/RLS/FORCE-RLS and deployed role topology remain open.

criteria.description: Reversal reopens current billing/financial/receivable projections while preserving historical receipt/payment relationships, keeps the encounter closed until explicit reopen, and permits a later cash receipt.
criteria.limitations: The bounded proof covers the full-BRL cash path only; broader financial settlement and close/reopen policy remain open.

criteria.description: TDD RED history is retained and the corrected focused suite, fresh database suite, full API regression, builds, typechecks, lint, formatting, security and coverage pass.
criteria.limitations: Official coverage excludes the repository's designated database integration exclusions; remote CI and critical browser E2E are not claimed by this gate.

criteria.description: A fresh independent read-only post-fix review finds no Critical, High, Medium or Low blocker within the bounded slice.
criteria.limitations: The review is static/read-only and does not replace target execution, provider homologation or operational acceptance.

criteria.description: The bounded result is reconciled without promoting the parent program, strict Vetus parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness or release acceptance.
criteria.limitations: Global parity remains 98/100 with 4/11 verified, clinical parity 100/100 with 2/3 verified, and enterprise readiness 95/100 with 42 PASS / 3 WARN / 1 FAIL.

gaps: Disposable local PostgreSQL does not certify target TCP/RLS/FORCE-RLS or production runtime-role topology.
Provider refunds, chargebacks, bank reconciliation, fiscal cancellation and non-cash reversal remain out of scope.
Browser acceptance, remote CI, distributed worker failure/observability, accessibility, operations, backup/restore, RTO/RPO and release acceptance remain open.
Global Vetus and clinical parity remain partial/open; the enterprise readiness check retains one strict-parity FAIL and three external-operation WARNs.
conditions: Keep the source settlement graph and reversal graph append-only.
Retain tenant-scoped authorization, idempotency and runtime role grants before extending this path.
Revalidate before adding non-cash/provider refunds, target operation, production/deployment action or release acceptance.

Exclude providers, credentials, target, production, deployment and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before adding non-cash/provider refunds, chargebacks, bank settlement, target operation, production/deployment action or release acceptance.

next_action: Keep CVG-004 and the global program IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL; continue only with a separately authorized implementation-ready gap and do not promote this bounded result to parity, readiness or release.
revalidation_triggers: Any PIX/card/bank/provider refund or chargeback behavior
Any non-cash receipt, cash-register policy, journal account-plan or fiscal integration change
Any target, credential, production, deployment, external mutation or release action
